Free open-source OCR pipeline for invoice and receipt extraction.

Extracts: vendor, date, total, invoice number, line items, multi-currency support.

**Try the live demo:** https://uspourmirza-boop.github.io/hermes-invoice-extract/

**Quick start:**

pip install -r requirements.txt
python src/extract.py invoice.jpg

Works offline. No API keys. No subscriptions. MIT licensed.

Let me know if you try it — feedback welcome!
